capabilities: Increase the blockquote level of the current line or selection
Decrease the blockquote level of the current line or selection
Process multiple selections with differing quote levels individually
extras: Pre-release versions can be installed via BRAT; the Showcase section is empty and bug reports go to GitHub Issues, with discussions hosted on the author's ActionsDotWork Forum.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for raising or lowering blockquote prefixes (>), especially across multiple lines or selections.

relations.evidence: the obsidian-tasks crew for the "starter templates" for the GitHub Action workflow

summary: Commands plugin that adds two commands to increase or decrease the Markdown blockquote level of the current line or selection(s).
